thresholds.source: Espressif ESP32-S3 datasheet (recommended VDD 3.0-3.6V, VIH=0.75*VDD, VIL=0.25*VDD): https://documentation.espressif.com/esp32-s3_datasheet_en.html + ASSUMPTION 12 dB FS ~3.1 V
resistor tolerance propagation; project gauge requirement

notes: DC + resistor-tolerance MC pass. 100k/100k draws ~21 uA and stays inside the ADC range. Source impedance 50k is high, but C13=100nF supplies the SAR sampling charge; DC leakage is the remaining risk (see mcu_battery_divider_leakage). ADC full-scale 3.1 V is an ASSUMPTION for 12 dB attenuation - verify with esp_adc_cal.
